item.title: CVE-2025-13032: Entering and Breaking the Avast Antivirus Sandbox Part 2
item.description:
📝 v=ry4SNYe2f68Bug ExplanationThe bug we want to exploit is a double fetch issue that leads to a kernel pool overflow. Our goal is to exploit this pool overflow to gain an arbitrary kernel read/write primitive and achieve a local privilege escalation. The paged pool is a region of Windows kernel memory used for objects and data that the kernel or drivers need, but that can be paged out to disk.
🔗 Read more: https://www.safateam.com/intelligence-hub/research/technical-articles/cve-2025-13032-entering-and-breaking-the-avast-antivirus-sandbox-part-2

item.title: Uproar in France over award-winning author accused of using AI
item.description:
📝 He said he was "compiling a dossier" with his editor to prove that he authentically wrote the book. Research has found that AI-detectors can wrongly flag human writing as AI-generated and miss text that was produced by artificial intelligence, particularly if it has been edited or paraphrased. Orélien told Libération that the first draft of the book was written in 2019 – well before AI programmes to generate text became generally available.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ck7v4y45893go
